title: OpenAI窃密案：录音设备藏会议室，AI人才争夺暗流涌动
speaker: Morgan Meager

segments.en: This week emerged that according to details released by the Justice Department, the absolute Raham Alphosen, he had been arrested last week.
segments.zh: 本周根据司法部公布的细节，拉哈姆·阿尔福森已于上周被捕。

segments.en: He was a employee in the product team in open AIs, headquarters in San Francisco.
segments.zh: 他曾是OpenAI旧金山总部产品团队的员工。

segments.en: What emerged is that he has also been charged on planting a secret recording device.
segments.zh: 目前披露的是，他还被指控安装秘密录音设备。

segments.en: What kind of emerged through details released by the Justice Department was this recording device was discovered in one of the conference rooms and it was plugged into the back of the TV.
segments.zh: 司法部公布的细节显示，该录音设备是在一间会议室里被发现的，插在电视背面。

segments.en: Almost disguised, it was covered in toilet paper.
segments.zh: 它几乎被伪装起来，外面裹着卫生纸。

segments.en: They haven't been able to find out what the recording device was trying to do because its contents were encrypted.
segments.zh: 由于设备内容经过加密，他们尚无法查明该录音设备的意图。

segments.en: But I think what is interesting about this is the Justice Department said that chatbot logs associated with an account by Abdul Rahm and Spouse had had details where someone had been asking the chatbot for advice on how to install a recording device like this and also how to use cases.
segments.zh: 但有趣的是，司法部表示，与阿卜杜勒·拉赫姆及其配偶账户相关的聊天机器人日志显示，有人曾向聊天机器人咨询如何安装此类录音设备以及使用场景。

segments.en: Katrina Mulligan, who is a senior member of open AIs national security team, estimated that just half of the 300 top AI researchers in the world are American.
segments.zh: OpenAI国家安全团队高级成员卡特里娜·穆里根估计，全球300名顶尖AI研究员中仅一半是美国人。

segments.en: And this presents a problem. There's this balance between wanting to keep this technology secure in a race where the easiest way to catch up is to just steal it.
segments.zh: 这带来了一个问题：在希望保持技术安全的竞赛中，追赶的最简单方式就是窃取。

segments.en: Is this going to become a harder and harder debate because these skills are lacking here in the U.S. But they have to be careful with who they're hiring.
segments.zh: 由于美国缺乏这些技能，这场辩论是否会越来越激烈？但他们必须谨慎选择雇佣对象。

segments.en: Yeah, and this is interesting because this person who has been arrested, he's a Saudi national. He's been a resident in the U.S. since 2020 and has been a lot of attention paid to his nationality and also to the fact that he himself has talked openly about advising Saudi government agencies about their technology use.
segments.zh: 是的，有趣的是，被捕者是沙特国民，自2020年起居住在美国。他的国籍以及他公开谈论为沙特政府机构提供技术使用建议一事，引发了大量关注。
